digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action and Jira integration
propositions: The Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails consistently with JQL parse error on live Jira because projects.json was corrupted with nonexistent rehearsal fixture keys (LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira Cloud.

The fetcher multi-project fan-out in story-1734 iterates over all keys in read_projects() and issues one JQL query per key; when LEG is the first key, the query 'project = LEG AND status != Done' is syntactically valid per _PROJECT_KEY_RE but rejected by Jira, causing ACLI exit 1 and reconcile_once to raise.

The live tickets branch projects.json was overwritten with the rehearsal fixture mapping via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) authored by the test-fixture identity at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent failure at 2026-08-15T02:39Z.

The canonical intended state of projects.json is {version: 1, legacy_default: 'REB', projects: {}} (empty projects map), which was the known-good green-run state at commit 0d9f4b8459 and matches the ensure-registry seed.
Bridge-state writes lack the unified store write lock, atomic commit, and auto-push that protect tickets branch mutations, allowing the ad-hoc hand-commits that leaked rehearsal keys into production.
